title: VozNativa v0.4 hardening / v0.5 -> Assertiva 0.10.1 dogfood feedback
authority: Assertiva executed directly by the VozNativa round on Windows 11; same model family built, audited and judged. Not an independent qualification; nothing repaired in Assertiva.

findings.summary: a test file given to --mutate-tests becomes 'unittest discover -s FILE' (ImportError); no mutant runs and the finding says MUTATION_REPORT_UNREADABLE
findings.reproducer: synthetic calc/ + tests/test_calc.py with CI declaring unittest discover; --mutate calc/__init__.py --mutate-tests tests/test_calc.py
findings.acceptance: a file selection runs that file for baseline and mutants; a selection that cannot run is reported as a selection failure

findings.summary: a filter inside a loop over fixed data is told to 'make the check unconditional'; the effective fix is a non-vacuity assertion
findings.reproducer: loop over CASES with if expected: assertTrue(...)
findings.control: breaking the function under test makes the test fail
findings.acceptance: filtered-loop shape gets resolve_with = non-vacuity count or a negative control on the selection

findings.summary: unittest runs record source_identity, interpreter and temp_root as null; pytest runs record them
findings.acceptance: unittest evidence names where project modules were imported from

findings.summary: installed-wheel tests NOT_RUN ('no test runner adapter for this project') on a project the unittest adapter ran
findings.acceptance: the unittest adapter runs the suite against the installed artifact

findings.summary: a stdlib-only TestCase project without CI or config is treated as pytest and BLOCKED
findings.acceptance: fallback to unittest discovery, or the runner reported as unknown

true_positives: CONDITIONAL_ASSERTION led to one confirmed false green in VozNativa (fixed in ada5aa6)
native unittest execution with coverage and wheel build/install in a disposable copy
TAUTOLOGY and a real Cosmic Ray survivor in the reproducer
